chapters.text: Every way leads come into AMS by themselves: website form, Facebook, Zameen and other portals, Zapier, Google Sheets.
Open CRM, then Settings, then Automation hub.
Each card shows if a channel is on and how many leads it brought this week.
For Zameen, Graana or Zapier, make an API connection and give them the link and key.
Click Send a test lead to check everything works.
